name: http_domcase
summary: HTTP domain-case desync strategy — flips Host-header casing to defeat token-match censors.

layers.fixHint: Implement the DesyncStrategy in a ripdpi-strategy-* crate (a new crate or one of the existing buckets). Strategy id must equal the wireId.

Contribute a StrategyStepRegistration to STRATEGY_STEP_REGISTRATIONS via #[linkme::distributed_slice]. Pick the StrategyStepFactory variant (Stateless / Configured / Unimplemented) that matches the step shape.
Add a StepType variant (and to StepType::ALL), the canonical wire id in registry_id(), and any historical aliases in from_wire(). descriptor_drift.rs pins this against the registry.

If the strategy lives in a NEW crate, add `extern crate ripdpi_strategy_<name> as _;` to ripdpi-strategy-registry/src/lib.rs so linkme picks up the slice entry. This is the only central edit the registration path needs.

checklist: Implement `DesyncStrategy` in a ripdpi-strategy-* crate (id == wireId).
Contribute a StrategyStepRegistration to STRATEGY_STEP_REGISTRATIONS with the correct StrategyStepFactory variant.

If the strategy lives in a new crate, add `extern crate ripdpi_strategy_<name> as _;` to ripdpi-strategy-registry/src/lib.rs.
Existing drift tests in ripdpi-strategy-registry/tests/descriptor_drift.rs will catch any one-sided edit; verify they still pass.
